title: Perfect recipe for an organized job search 🔎
description:
Without a plan to organize your job search, it can quickly turn into chaos. Follow these steps to boost your organization to 11 and start getting more interviews:

1) Narrow down what you want and ONLY search for these things.

2) Make a job search routine and STICK to it.

3) Track down EVERY detail about your search so you don’t have to remember things yourself. #jobsearch #jobsearching #jobsearchtips #jobsearchstruggles #jobtracker
